topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor virology and the discovery of cellular oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses and experimental transformation assays led to the discovery and characterisation of cellular proto-oncogenes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional classification of cancer genes and illustrate how mutations alter cell cycle regulation and allele dosage dynamics.

topics.label: Origins and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the molecular pathways and cellular defects that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited mutations drives cancer progression and tumor evolution.

topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary, reading recommendations, and an outlook on the next lecture.
